scripts.build:process-watcher: dotnet restore process_watcher/ProcessWatcher.csproj && dotnet build process_watcher/ProcessWatcher.csproj -c Release
scripts.build:copy-assets: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force assets build/; Copy-Item -Force config.json build/; Copy-Item -Force game_process_names.txt build/; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force process_watcher/bin/Release/net8.0-windows build/process_watcher/; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules/better-sqlite3 build/node_modules/better-sqlite3; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules/bindings build/node_modules/bindings; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules/file-uri-to-path build/node_modules/file-uri-to-path"
scripts.build: npm run build:process-watcher && npm run build:bundle && npm run check:build && npm run build:pkg && npm run build:copy-assets && npm run check:dev
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue dist, build, process_watcher/bin, process_watcher/obj"
